lines.text: Hello, am I speaking with the owner of [Business Name]?
lines.textKn: Hello, namaste. Naanu [Business Name] owner jothe mathadtha irodha?

lines.text: Could I speak with the owner? I have some research data about their business I wanted to share directly with them.
lines.textKn: Owner jothe mathadoke aaguttha? Navu avra business bagge swalpa research data collect maadidvi, adhannu avrge direct aagi share maadbekitthu.

lines.condition: Once the owner is on the phone
lines.text: Hi! My name is Afifa, I'm calling from FortuneMarq Media & Marketing — we're a digital growth agency based right here in [City].
lines.textKn: Hi sir! Nanna hesru Afifa antha. Naanu FortuneMarq Media & Marketing indha call maadtha idhini — namma company Hubli based.

lines.text: Sir, what language is comfortable for you?
lines.textKn: Sir, nimge yav language comfortable ide?

lines.text: We've done some market research specifically for [Niche] businesses in [City], and the data is quite interesting. I just need 2 minutes of your time — is this a good time to talk?
lines.textKn: Sir, navu [City] nalli iro [Niche] businesses bagge market research maadidvi. Kelavu numbers and data thumba interesting aagide. 2 minutes bekitthu — ega matadbauda?

objections.response: Okay sir, no problem — can I call you back in an hour or later this evening?
objections.responseKn: No problem sir, yawadg call madli?

objections.response: No worries. Mind if I ask — is there a specific reason you don't want to do digital marketing for your business?
objections.responseKn: No problem sir. Yake anta kelbauda, yen reason sir?

lines.text: Every month, [Search Volume] people in [City] search for [Niche] on Google. (Pause 2 seconds) Out of those, [Search Volume] potential customers are directly looking in the market for the services you provide, sir.
lines.textKn: Prathi thinglu, namma [City] nalli approx [Search Volume] jana Google nalli [Niche] gagi search maadthaidhare. (Pause 2 seconds) Adhralle [Search Volume] potential customers direct aagi neevu kodthiro servicegene market nalli hudukthaidhare sir.

objections.trigger: We get enough business through word of mouth
objections.triggerKn: Namge mouth publicity indhane thumba business barutthe
objections.response: That's really good — word of mouth is solid. But those [Search Volume] monthly searches are people who don't know you yet and are actively looking for your service right now. That's completely new business on top of what you already have.
objections.responseKn: Adhu thumba olledhu sir — word of mouth yavagludru best-e. Aadre Google nalli search mado ee [Search Volume] jana nimge innu gothilladhavru, matte egle direct aagi nimm service beku antha hudukthirovru. Idhu nimge eega barthiro business safe-aagi, completely hosa business thara add aagutthe sir.

lines.text: Right now [Search Volume] people search every month — but there's no way for them to find [Business Name] on Google directly. JustDial and directories are capturing the majority of that demand. You're completely invisible to those potential customers.
lines.textKn: Eega prathi thinglu [Search Volume] jana online nalli search maadthaidhare — aadre avrge Google nalli nimma [Business Name] direct aagi hudukoke yavu option illa. JustDial matte bere directories eirodhrindha, ee customersna avre thagolthaidhare. So online huduko potential customersge neevu completely invisible idhhiri sir.

lines.text: Most [Niche] businesses in [City] are in the same position — nobody's really set up online yet. So whoever gets there first will pull in most of those customers.
lines.textKn: Namma [City] nalli iro maximum [Niche] businesses innu idhe position nalli idhare. Yarru innu online nalli thumba strong aagi munde bandilla. So eega neevu first step thagondre, ee complete online spacena neevu own maadbahu sir.

objections.trigger: I don't think I need a website
objections.response: Many business owners feel that way until they see the numbers. [Search Volume] people every month are searching specifically for what you do — and right now every single one of those searches is going to someone else.
objections.responseKn: Tumba jana business owners modhlu hinge ankothare sir, aadre numbers nodidhaga artha aagutthe. [Search Volume] jana prathi thinglu neevu mado servicege specific aagi hudukthaidhare — matte eega avrella direct aagi nimma competitors hatra hogthaidhare sir.

lines.text: We help local [Niche] businesses show up on Google directly — not through JustDial, not through directories. Your own website, your own Google ranking, your own enquiries coming straight to you.
lines.textKn: Navu local [Niche] businessesge direct aagi Google nalli rank aagoke help maadthivi — JustDial illa bere directories moolaka alla. Nimde aadhondu website, nimma Google ranking, matte enquiries direct aagi nimge baro thara maadthivi sir.

lines.text: We've built this system specifically for local businesses in [City]. Everything is connected — the website, the SEO, the Google presence — and we manage it so you don't have to.
lines.textKn: Navu ee complete systemna namma [City] nalli iro local businessesgagi design maadidvi. Idhralli website, SEO, Google presence... ella linked aagirutthe — matte idhnnella navu complete aagi manage maadthivi, nimge yenu madodu iralla.

lines.text: Our founder gets on a quick Google Meet with you — you can join right from your phone.
lines.textKn: Namma founder nimma jothe ond sanna Google Meet call maadthare sir — neevu nimma phone indhane join aagbahu.

lines.text: He'll walk you through a short presentation, made just for your business here in [City].
lines.textKn: Avru namma [City] nalli iro nimma businessgagi special aagi ready maadiro ond sanna presentation thoristhare.

lines.text: And even if you don't go ahead with anything, you'll come away knowing exactly where your business stands online.
lines.textKn: Neevu namma service thagolila andhru parvagilla sir — online nalli nimma business eega yava position nalli ide antha clear aagi gothagutthe.

lines.text: When would you be free? I'll book the Google Meet call and send you the link on WhatsApp.
lines.textKn: Neevu yavaga free idhhiri sir? Naanu Google Meet call book maadi, link-na nimge WhatsApp nalli share maadthini.

lines.condition: If they want to see something first
lines.text: Absolutely — I'll send you the report on WhatsApp right now. Whenever you're ready, we'll set up the Google Meet call.
lines.textKn: Khanditha sir — naanu egle report-na nimge WhatsApp nalli kalisthini. Neevu adhnnu nodi ready aadhmele navu Google Meet call set up madona sir.

lines.text: It's completely free, no commitment at all. Our founder just walks you through your data — you decide if there's anything worth acting on.
lines.textKn: Idhu completely free sir, yavu commitment-e illa. Namma founder just nimma business data thoristhare — adu nodi neevu decide maad bahudu sir.

objections.response: We don't have fixed prices — our founder first understands your business and what you actually need. Pricing is decided based on that. Nobody in Hubli right now offers pricing like ours.
objections.responseKn: Navu yavu fixed pricing itkondilla sir — namma founder modhlu nimma business matte nimma exact requirementna artha maadkothare. Pricing adhra mele decide aagutthe. Matte eega Hubli nalli yaaru namma range-ige pricing matte quality offer madtha illa sir.

objections.trigger: We tried digital marketing before and it didn't work
objections.triggerKn: Navu modhlu try maadidvi, yenu work aaglilla
objections.response: That happens a lot — most agencies just run ads with no foundation underneath. What we do is different: we build the whole system first.
objections.responseKn: Adhu thumba kade aagutthe sir, gothide — maximum agencies just yaavdhondu foundation illadhe ads run maadthare. Aadre navu mado process bere ide: navu modhlu complete system built maadi, aadhmele munde hogthivi sir.

objections.trigger: The owner isn't available / Someone else handles this
objections.response: No problem — when is the owner usually free? Or I can WhatsApp the report first so they can have a look before we set up the call.
objections.responseKn: No problem sir — owner yavaga free irthare general aagi? Illa andre naanu modhlu report-na WhatsApp maadthini, avru adhnnu nodi free aadhmele navu call set up maadbahudu sir.

objections.trigger: Just send me information on WhatsApp
objections.response: Of course — I'll send the report right now. The Google Meet call with our founder will make a lot more sense after you've had a look.
objections.responseKn: Khanditha sir — naanu egle complete report-na WhatsApp maadthini. Neevu adhnnu nodidhmele namma founder jothe mado Google Meet call innu clear aagi artha aagutthe sir.

objections.response: Absolutely, take your time. I'll send the report on WhatsApp and follow up in a couple of days — no pressure.
objections.responseKn: Khanditha sir, time thagoli. Naanu report-na WhatsApp nalli kalisi, ond eradu dhina aadhmele follow-up maadthini — yenu pressure illa sir.

objections.trigger: We handle marketing internally / We have someone
objections.response: Good to know. The Google Meet call might still be useful — our founder can show you what the market data says and you can see if there are gaps worth filling.
objections.responseKn: Adhu thumba olledhu sir. Aadru ee Google Meet call nimge useful aagbahudu — market data yenu helthaide antha namma founder thoristhare, adhralli enadru gaps idhre neevu nimma internal team moolaka fill maadbahu sir.

Hi! This is Afifa from FortuneMarq. I'm sending you the research report we prepared for [Niche] businesses in [City] — please find it attached. Once you've had a look, let's set up a quick Google Meet call with our founder. Completely free, no commitment. [PDF Attachment]
Hi! Afifa from FortuneMarq here. I'll follow up with you on [Follow Up Date]. Here's the report in the meantime — [PDF Attachment]
Hi! Afifa from FortuneMarq here. I'll follow up with you on [Follow Up Date]. Hope you've had a chance to look at the report — let me know if you have any questions in the meantime.

Hi! This is Afifa from FortuneMarq. Here are some results we've delivered for businesses like yours: [Portfolio Link]. Have a look and let's set up a quick Google Meet call with our founder whenever you're free.
